title: Welcome to the notes example
body: This list is seeded from data/notes.json through a resource, then kept in a signal and mirrored to localStorage.

title: Routing
body: Each note has its own URL. Links are plain anchors; the router handles same-origin clicks and leaves the rest to the browser.

title: Forms
body: The editor is a native form with constraint validation. The title input gets focus through a ref signal.
